C0457.title: Shenzhen Futian Police Crack Down on Illicit Mobile SIM Supply Chain
C0457.summary: In July and August 2021, Shenzhen Futian police launched Operation Broken Stream to dismantle criminal networks that procured and resold illicit mobile SIMs for telecom fraud. The operation resulted in 81 arrests, the seizure of nearly 40,000 unauthorized SIM cards, and multiple GOIP devices, disrupting underground workshops that supplied tools to overseas fraud dens.

references.title: Shenzhen cracks over 6,400 telecom fraud cases in 8 months, reported incidents drop 36% year-on-year
